fresh byte verification. Missing historical receipts remain unverified.
Does not collect, fetch or modify evidence.

name: seo_project_task_detail
summary: Read one project task definition, evidence and bounded history.
notes:
Reads saved local evidence with metadata-only receipt status; this is not
fresh byte verification. Missing historical receipts remain unverified.
Does not collect, fetch or modify evidence.

name: seo_project_task_comment
summary: Append a comment to a custom project task with an optional scan/finding link.
notes:
The comment records its actor and timestamp. expected_revision prevents overwriting a
newer checklist update. This writes local project metadata and makes no network request.

name: seo_project_export
summary: Start a complete task, task-comments, task-history or compare.v2 export under reports/.
notes:
The job returns immediately with an ID; use project_export_status to read bounded
progress and project_export_cancel to request cancellation. Successful outputs are
recorded in project export history. No network request is made.

name: seo_project_export_status
summary: Read progress and completion state for one local project export job.

name: seo_project_export_cancel
summary: Request cancellation of a running local project export job.

name: seo_project_exports_page
summary: Read the bounded newest-first project export history.

name: seo_project_scans
summary: Read a bounded page of retained project scans with evidence metadata.
notes: Reads saved local evidence only; does not collect, fetch or modify it.

name: seo_remediation_summary
summary: Read explicit remediation and recheck coverage from retained local evidence.
notes:
The result keeps verified original cases, resolved, persisting,
regressed, false-positive-reviewed and unverifiable states separate.
It does not run a crawl or infer that omitted evidence is clean.

name: seo_remediation_create
summary: Create one new empty remediation ledger bound to a validated local project.
notes:
producer_build must be the full lowercase 40-character Git SHA of the
build that writes the ledger. An existing path is refused; ledgers never
overwrite.

name: seo_remediation_ingest
summary: Ingest one retained saved audit into a local ledger without rerunning a crawl.
notes:
The scan is opened read-only. Re-ingesting the same revision is idempotent;
a new revision appends observation history.

name: seo_workflow_start
summary: Start a local registered workflow; it performs no scan or provider call.

name: seo_workflow_checkpoint
summary: Persist one registered-step result before the next step or agent handoff.

name: seo_workflow_status
summary: Recover the exact next registered step after interruption or handoff.

name: seo_workflow_execute
summary: Checkpoint a supplied local sequence without executing network work.

name: seo_workflow_resume
summary: Reopen only the interrupted registered step after a second-agent handoff.

name: seo_monitor_configure
summary: Configure a disabled local incremental monitor; this starts no schedule or message delivery.

name: seo_monitor_run
summary: Record one bounded retained-scan diff; quiet runs do not notify anyone.

name: seo_monitor_schedule
summary: Claim or recover a local run; no timer, crawl, or delivery starts here.

name: seo_schedule_show
summary: Read a project's scheduled-scan settings, last run, and next due window.

name: seo_schedule_set
summary: Merge a partial update into the project's schedule settings; starts nothing.

name: seo_schedule_run_due
summary: Run the project's scheduled scans now if they are due; crawls over the network.

name: seo_schedule_install
summary: Write a launchd plist, cron line, or Task Scheduler command; never loads it.

name: seo_schedule_uninstall
summary: Remove the trigger file written by seo_schedule_install; does not unload it.

name: seo_monitor_collect
summary: Preview or explicitly collect one previously claimed bounded monitor plan.
notes:
The default preview makes no HTTP request. apply=true collects only the
validated claim, retains body/validation provenance within its bounds and
records failed, partial or complete outcomes. Expired or interrupted claims
require an explicit new start. No timer, background service or delivery starts.

name: seo_monitor_local_deliver
summary: Record a deduplicated local receipt for one retained monitoring run.
notes:
The destination is fixed to local:receipt. It uses no network or external
transport and does not claim that any recipient outside the project received it.

name: seo_monitor_status
summary: Read local monitor policy and its last retained checkpoint.

name: seo_remediation_cases
summary: Read a bounded page of exact remediation cases and decision history.

name: seo_remediation_transition
summary: Append one revision-safe, evidence-bound lifecycle decision.
notes:
Measured outcomes require a later retained observation. A user claim,
missing source or failed fetch cannot resolve a case.

name: seo_remediation_record_verification
summary: Attach a retained bounded verification artifact to pending cases.
notes:
Every result must map to exactly one pending ledger case. The artifact
byte digest is saved in the decision evidence; ambiguous or stale
batches are rejected atomically.

name: seo_remediation_recheck
summary: Recheck exact pending ledger cases without widening to a site crawl.
notes:
The baseline must be the retained audit that produced each case. The
command writes a separate immutable verification artifact, then records
its hashes and measured outcome atomically in the local ledger.

name: seo_remediation_report
summary: Render retained before/after remediation evidence without network access.
notes:
With out_dir this creates a new immutable JSON/Markdown review snapshot;
without it, it returns the JSON-ready report document only.

name: seo_evidence_normalize
summary: Normalize a supplied CSV/XLSX/JSON or saved provider envelope, fully offline.
notes:
Every row keeps its declared grain, provenance and availability state: a
measured zero stays zero while missing, null, blank, suppressed,
uncollected and failed inputs stay unavailable. Restricted sources
return counts and redacted provenance; normalized rows live only in an
explicit private ``out_dir`` artifact. No provider, DNS or page fetch
ever runs here.

name: seo_evidence_join
summary: Join normalized analytics/search evidence to crawl pages, offline only.
notes:
Retains matched, crawl-only, external-only and unkeyable populations
with per-field provenance, and reports key collisions instead of
multiplying rows. ``compare`` plus a declared ``policy`` yields a pure
compatible/incompatible/unknown decision across period, timezone,
identity, attribution, engine and grain; source metrics such as GSC
clicks and GA4 sessions stay distinct and are never summed. Restricted
inputs return counts only.

name: seo_bi_filter
summary: Filter a verified local BI package into a new typed package and optional XLSX.
notes:
Exact equality filters over declared fields only; source and selected row counts
and coverage are preserved. Creates new local outputs without network calls.

name: seo_bi_export
summary: Project a saved scan or audit and optional issue #781 joins into a local typed BI package.

name: seo_bi_sheets_plan
summary: Preflight a complete local BI package for Sheets without Google access or writes.

name: seo_publication_cohorts
summary: Project saved publication metadata and normalized provider evidence locally.
notes:
Publication, modification and first-observed dates stay distinct. GSC
and analytics observations stay separately labelled; this makes no
causal traffic claim and never calls a provider.

name: seo_gsc_progress
summary: Project saved GSC query evidence into branded/non-branded summaries.
notes:
Matching is supplied by versioned aliases. Missing query rows remain
unknown, and average-position values are never rank-placement claims.

name: seo_bi_bigquery_plan
summary: Describe an optional BigQuery load offline; it never selects a project or writes data.

name: seo_bi_destination_apply
summary: Request a BI destination write; host authorization is required and credentials are never accepted.

name: sf_audit_run
summary: Run an SF audit and write audit.json plus audit.md.
notes:
Use ``parse-exports`` with a directory of existing CSV/XLSX exports;
this mode does not require Screaming Frog to be installed. The
``load-crawl``, ``crawl``, and ``crawl-list`` modes invoke the separately
installed, licensed SF CLI. ``input`` is respectively an exports
directory, .seospider path, start URL, or URL-list file. Returns a compact
summary and absolute file paths instead of embedding the large reports.

``config`` may explicitly select ``semantic_similarity.adapter`` and
caller-supplied body/title/H1 vectors. No embedding model or provider
is selected by default; absent bodies or adapters remain unavailable.

``inspect_gsc`` explicitly enables a bounded live Search Console URL Inspection sample.
It requires a project-bound GSC property, stores results in that project's private local
inspection history, and applies a local 2,000-request-per-property-per-UTC-day budget.
By default this run reads only retained GSC/analytics history and makes no provider call.

A live crawl can run for a long time; this call runs off the server's
event loop, so other sf_* calls stay answerable while it is in
progress, and cancelling the request (an MCP CancelledNotification)
stops the underlying Screaming Frog process instead of leaving it
running. A cancelled or failed run never leaves a completed-looking
``audit.json``/``audit.md`` behind; on either outcome, or a lost
response, recover by pointing sf_list_exports/sf_audit_summary at the
same ``out`` path.

name: sf_audit_summary
summary: Read a compact health summary from audit.json or a scan.v1 SQLite artifact.
notes:
Returns the project, health score, severity counts, the first 15 ranked
checks, and sitemap statistics without loading the complete issue list
into the agent context.

name: sf_audit_issues
summary: Return filtered issues from audit.json or a validated scan.v1 SQLite artifact.
notes:
The requested limit is clamped to 1..1000 to keep MCP payloads bounded.
Omit both filters to inspect the first issues in report order.

name: sf_list_exports
summary: Discover recognized SF exports in a directory.
notes:
Returns the matched files by logical export name and the logical exports
that are absent, allowing an agent to explain which checks may be skipped
before running the audit.

name: sf_audit_tasks
summary: Build tasks.json and tasks.md from audit.json or a scan.v1 SQLite artifact.
notes:
Priority, severity inclusion, grouping, effort estimates, and URL caps
come from the configured ``tasks_pipeline``. ``check_assignment`` uses
only declared template/component URLs or validated audit segments and
preserves grouping provenance and candidate/declared/confirmed state.
Returns a compact summary and absolute paths to both backlog files.

name: sf_snippet_edits
summary: Import supplied snippet CSV text and write unapplied review tasks to a new JSON file.
notes:
The CSV needs ``url`` and at least one of ``title`` or ``description``. Empty edit cells
leave that field unchanged. Optional ``metrics`` names local font profiles with
``font_path`` and ``font_size``; their widths are typography measurements, not Google or
Yandex truncation predictions. ``retained_scan`` can add bounded, offline content context
for those exact URLs; ``query`` selects a visible-text excerpt and requires that scan.
Existing output files are never replaced.

name: seo_semantics_status
summary: Read a semantic core's phrase counters, provider units used and the next stage, without migrating or writing its database. project is the semantic project directory, or a SEOHEAD project workspace whose semantics/ subdirectory holds the core.

name: seo_semantics_run
summary: Run one free semantic-core stage or preview an import/export without writes. Import accepts CSV or XLSX, sheet selection, explicit field-to-column mapping and add/update/replace merge policy. Export and Excel accept all, cluster:<name> or no-landing scope. Phrases and evidence are retained; statuses change reversibly. No network access; paid stages are refused here (use seo_semantics_paid).

name: seo_semantics_mine
summary: Fetch the most frequent competitor pages from the core's cached SERP and append title/heading 2-3-grams to synonyms.txt as candidate phrases. Reads public pages; spends no provider quota. Run seo_semantics_paid stage=synonyms afterwards to check them.

name: seo_semantics_paid
summary: Preview or run one paid semantic-core stage: collect (Wordstat expansion of seeds.txt), synonyms (Wordstat check of synonyms.txt), cluster (Yandex Search SERP, cached per phrase; method=louvain needs the semantics extra) or exact (Arsenkin !W, once, at the end). The offline estimate is returned before confirmation; paid: without confirm_paid=true nothing is sent. Every submission is reserved before the call, so an interrupted or ambiguous request is never paid for twice; charges land in the shared spend journal (seo_spend_report).

name: seo_semantics_clusters
summary: Read paginated semantic clusters and nullable frequency aggregates.

name: seo_semantics_cluster_show
summary: Read one semantic cluster, its phrases aggregate and stored landing candidates.

name: seo_semantics_cluster_queries
summary: Read a bounded page of phrases belonging to one semantic cluster.

name: seo_semantics_set_landing
summary: Set or clear a cluster landing URL and retain an audit record.

name: seo_semantics_insights
summary: Read weekly GSC, Metrika and Webmaster evidence by cluster and bound resource, and evaluate rules. Reads local provider history and project bindings only; never fetches providers. Missing values stay null with a reason.

name: seo_semantics_insights_tasks
summary: Preview or write only selected matched rule/cluster pairs as project checklist items.
notes:
The call never executes the task. A write requires confirm=true and the checklist
expected_revision, preventing stale or duplicate task updates.
